verdict.rationale: Cognee is open-source (GitHub repo) and docs provide a documented single-command Docker run for local/self-hosted deployment (`docker run ... cognee/cognee:main`), plus explicit messaging that the full memory engine can be run locally or on your own stack for free. Community commentary raises concerns about complexity/overkill but does not contradict that self-hosting via Docker works. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the Docker deployment working in production, and more detail on infrastructure requirements/scaling for self-hosted setups.
